definitions.name: Spirea japonica - Dwarf Spirea
definitions.description: This model is from DynaSCAPE Software's Sketch3D download site, a huge online database of landscape components for SketchUp. This model is one of the FREE models offered on the site for anyone to use. This model is made up of 3D branches and leaves with 2D textures for the flowers and a poly count of just over 1300.       Note: when using models with 2D textures you will get the best appearance when you set your transparency quality to 'Medium' and uncheck the 'Use Anti-aliased Textures'  option under Rendering in your model info.      Check out the huge collection of plants, garden structures, pools, ponds etc. at DynaSCAPE.com. You will also find textures and plugins created specifically for landscape modeling using SketchUp.
